label: Employee Portal of Pistus
text: All employees (anyone who is paid as an employee) will have a login and password. This is how they will set up ACH banking information, view and print paycheck stubs, view and print Form W2 and update federal and state W4 information. They can also request updates to name, address, phone, etc. with attached documentation. (i.e., for a name change, a new SSA card would be required to be uploaded). DASHBOARD when the employee logs in: The menu bar on the left-hand side is where all the magic happens! PERSONAL INFORMATION – the employee can verify information the company has for them and can request updates to certain information with uploaded documentation. All employees who have ACH direct deposit must upload a copy of their driver’s license (or other photo ID) for proof of identification. Each employee can also set up Google Authenticator for their phones. Under PROFESSION and PAY the employee can view their employment details, the working location for the employee, wage information, raise information and update the Federal W4 and state W4 forms. The PAY STUB menu option allows the employee to view or print all paystubs for all available years. The ‘Check my Withholding’ button is a link to the IRS Tax Withholding Estimator. W2 FORMS is where the employee can view and print W2 forms. The employee must consent to receive the W2 form electronically before they can view or print online. This consent can be revoked at any time for a paper W2 request. The ‘FILE NOW’ button opens a new window for our sister company On -Line Taxes, Inc., where the employee can set up an account to complete their annual income tax returns. TIME MANAGEMENT is only used by companies who wish to have their employees input their time through Pistus. The time cards link directly to the payroll module so that payroll can be approved and completed after all time is input. PTO, Vacation and Sick time can be managed through this item as well. EMPLOYEE EXPENSES is where employees can submit expenses for reimbursement or for employees who track business mileage and employees who have company credit cards. All expenses can be tracked with uploaded receipts. Reimbursable expenses will be approved and then added to the next payroll. Company credit card expenses will be added to the outstanding liability balance sheet account and corresponding expense account. MY REPORTS has the ability to create reports for each employee. Probably one of the most important areas for each employee will be the ACH INFO section. Here the employee can set up their bank account information for ACH direct deposit. You can have 1 bank or multiple banks. All banks must go through the verification process. 2 small deposits will be credited to the account and then must be verified before the account can be approved for direct deposit. After the account is approved, these deposits will be withdrawn on the next payroll date. The CALENDAR menu item is a work calendar that displays holidays observed, PTO/Vacation requests and other important dates to the company.

label: FastSurvey - Setting up an Account - How To
file: FastSurvey - Setting up an Account - How To.pdf
text: From the main FastSurvey Dashboard the tabs on the left will take you between this page and the Company Settings The Shortcuts section will have different options available for quick access in the software. Hovering your cursor over a shortcut will tell you where it goes The Options on the top of the screen will swap between the company dashboard page and the Survey creation software Switching to the Settings page will allow you to edit the company account information, set up Google Authenticator and manage your subscription and payment details The Menu on the left will allow you to switch between all the settings When you are on a page in the software there are often tabs at the top that will allow you to access different options on that page This button will convert you from a trial version to an active account Use the Android or iOS links to download the Google Authenticator app for your device When the app asks for a key it will be displayed here Once you are given an Authenticator code you can enter it here and click “Verify” Switching to the Survey or Campaign software will give you access to three new tabs on the left: Dashboard (current page), Settings and Reviews Switching From My Company to Campaign will bring you to survey creator There are two places to add a new Campaign Existing campaigns will be managed in the middle area after they are created When you start a new Campaign this page will have you setup the settings for the campaign such as the name, form size, which email addresses you want the responses sent to and what you want included in the response mail The left menu is all of the different question types you can include on the campaign You can drag the question types from the left into the survey page to create that type of question Clicking the Blue Box will allow you to edit the title of the current page The tabs at the top will allow you to manage different aspects of the campaign such as Unique Identifier settings, IP settings, and the Auto-Response Settings You can navigate to different pages of the campaign here. The (+) Plus Sign will create a new page. End page allows you to customize the final page When you drag a question into your survey there will be popup window that will allow you to edit the parameters of that question. These will be specific to the question type such as Star-Ratings and Multiple Choice Ratings Multiple questions can be dragged to the same page, or you can have one question per page if you prefer After a question has been added, hovering your cursor over the question will bring up this menu to allow further customization. Blue Box: Edit Original settings Three Circles: adds question logics (see next page) White Boxes: Copy question Red Trashcan: Delete question Question logics will allow your survey to respond according to how the reviewer answers a given question You can select the desired results in the “If the Answer” side of the page and under the “Then” side of the page you can choose how you want the survey to respond or where you want to direct that reviewer. The (+) plus and (-) minus signs can be used to add or remove a row The end page will have an option for you to edit with the Blue Box in order to add any final information to the campaign. Questions cannot be dragged onto the end page Editing the End Page will allow you to add extra lines for any final thoughts or information This option allows you to preview the survey The Auto-Response section will allow you to create, edit and set the default auto-response that is sent after a survey is completed This side of the screen is like you are creating a normal email and the check-box at the top will allow you to make the current response the default response. This side of the screen will allow you to enter mail tags. You use these when you are typing your response in place of specific company or reviewer names. When you put these tags in the response they will automatically fill in with that reviewer’s information as the email is sent to them.

text: From the Dashboard there are shortcuts available to take you directly into different sections of FastVault Hovering your cursor over an icon will give details on where the shortcut will take you Use the Navigation icons on the top of the screen to switch between the Company information and the FastVault Data Storage Software These tabs will take you between the Dashboard and the account settings Use the blue box icons to edit the information in that field Use the Navigation menu on the left to switch between editing company information, setting up Google Authenticator, and payment information Use the Android or iOS links to download the Google Authenticator app for your device When the app asks for a key it will be displayed here Once you are given an Authenticator code you can enter it here and click “Verify” You can use the SUBSCRIBE NOW button to complete payment when your trial period is expired The tabs across the top will allow you to see your transaction history as well as remove/update your card details The Tabs at the top left will let you manage the files, the files that are being shared, and settings for the file cabinet This is a current display of the available storage for the account Use the icons at the top to switch between the File Cabinet and Account information Any existing files/folders will be listed on this page. When you first visit this page you will instead see the option to either add a new file or add a new folder Use one of these options to begin storing data in the File Cabinet Use the “Browse” option to attach your file The “Category Type” menu will let you choose an existing category, or create a new category to store files under File description will allow you to add more details about the upload You can password protect files by checking the “Set Password Protected” box The password must be entered and confirmed prior to uploading if this box is check When adding a new folder you will only need to enter a folder name and select whether or not it will be password protected After you have created a file/folder the main Files page will change The option to add new files and folders are moved to the top left by using these icons Files and Folders you have created will be listed here by name The lock icon indicates that item is password protected Folders and files have different action options Folders: Eyeball: view folder Clipboard: manage folder details Trashcan: delete folder Folder: share folder Files: Down Arrow: download Pencil: edit Page: view file information Trashcan: delete file Three Dots: more options such as email file, password protect file and view downloads/history To share a file by email all you need to do is enter the email address and the date you want the share to expire These files can be password protected separately, and checking to allow a reply will allow the recipient to send a file back The tabs at the top of the share screen will allow you to view current and expired shares for that file To share a folder you will just need a recipient email address and to enter an expiry date Folder shares can be password protected The options at the bottom will set the level of access the recipient will have when receiving the folder The tabs at the top will allow you to manage the current and expired shares for the selected folder Moving to the Shares tab will allow you to manage all folder and file shares The menu on the left will allow you to swap between file and folder shares as well as manage your recycling bin Blue Square: this will allow you to update the details of the share Red Circle: This will allow you to manually expire the share In the Recycling Bin you will be given a few options to manage old files: Down Arrow: download the file Reverse Arrow: restores the file attachment Trashcan: deletes the file Moving the Settings tab will allow you to do things such as: revisit your dashboard Update the personal information section Manage the Google Authenticator View/manage your subscription details You can also now manage File Category as well as the Mail Template On the File Category page you can add new categories with the green Add New button at the top Existing categories can be edited with the Blue Box icon and deleted with the Trashcan icon Mail Templates are default messages that are sent to the recipient when you share files On the Mail Templatepage you can add a new template with the green Add New button at the top Mail Templates can be managed with the icons shown on this page: Blue Box: edit the template Trashcan: delete the template Eyeball: View the template “i”: view usage history When creating a mail template the left side of the page is used to enter the template name, the subject line, the download label and the written content of the message you want to send The right side of the page is where you can insert Mail Tags. These are generic tags that will automatically fill in with the specific information related to the tag you select. This means you do not have to customize each message that you send out after setting up the template

label: PISTUS Bank Payroll Setup Guide 2
text: Bank Setup Payroll Bank SETUP GUIDE V E RS I O N 2 0 2 6 . 1 What is Bank Setup (Payroll)? Bank Setup (Payroll) is where you add and verify the payroll bank account used to process: •Process payroll funding (Premium accounts only) •Process payroll tax payments Important: Your payroll bank account must be verified using the Micro Entry Verification process before electronic payroll funding and tax payments can begin. Two small verification deposits (Micro Entries) will be sent to your bank account for verification. Payroll Setup Wizard Access Bank Setup (Payroll) You can access Bank Setup (Payroll) at any time from: Payroll > Settings > Bank Setup Add the Payroll Bank Account: Select Add Bank Account to begin entering your payroll bank account information. Complete all required fields, then click Save. Example) Accounting Information – Defines how this payroll bank account will appear in your Chart of Accounts and which location it belongs to. Payroll Posting – Choose whether payroll transactions should post to this account and enter the effective payroll date. Bank Account Information – Enter the bank account details exactly as shown on your bank account or bank statement. Payroll Account Warning Bank Setup Summary Your payroll bank account has been added successfully. The Bank Setup Summary will now display your payroll bank account. The next step is bank account verification. Verification Process Once ACH Enrollment is approved, your company bank information will be processed or requested if not already submitted. Two small Micro Entries will then be sent to your bank account for verification. Once the Micro Entries appear in your bank account, return to Payroll > Settings > Bank Setup to complete the verification process. Micro Entries Alert – Verification Process Once the micro-entries have been sent, a dashboard alert will notify you that your bank account is ready for verification. Select the dashboard alert, then click the Verify (purple) icon. Tip: If verification indicates the amounts are incorrect, reverse the order of the two amounts and try again. Verify the Account ① Enter the first Micro Entry amount. ② Enter the second Micro Entry amount. ③ Upload the signed ACH Authorization Form. ④ Select the confirmation checkbox ⑤ Click Submit for Verification. ① ② ③ ④ ⑤ Bank Setup Complete Your payroll bank account has been successfully added and verified. Your payroll bank account is now ready to process payroll. ►► Form 8655 (Reporting Agent) Complete IRS Form 8655 to authorize PISTUS to file payroll tax forms and make tax payments on your behalf. label: Pistus Vendor Account Setup Guide
text: Pistus Vendor Accounts For a vendor to have an account; it has to be a 1099 vendor. Once the vendor is setup with an email address, a blue INVITE button will appear. After you click to send the invite, the software will display the details of when it was sent. Click the button and the vendor will receive the following email: When they click the SIGN UP button they will be taken to the following screen to set up their Pistus vendor account. The yellow fields are required After them complete the account creation; the next screen will display a message for the vendor to activate their account with an email sent to their email address. They will then receive the following email: When they click the orange ACTIVATE button they will be taken to the following screen. Next, they need to click the green LOGIN button and enter their account name and password on the login screen. This is the place they will log in every time to access their vendor account. The first time they login, they will have to read and agree to the Pistus user agreement. They can print and/or save the document if they want. After clicking the I AGREE button, they will have to select a method for 2 factor verification. If their phone number was entered they can select a text message. If no phone number was entered, they will only have the option for a code to their email. Once inside, they can add their phone number or set up google authenticator. Vendor Dashboard. Alerts like a 1099 being ready will appear here in the alert center. Company Information tab. Anything with a blue edit box can be updated. A request will then be sent to the company ADMIN for approval. 1099 Forms tab. Once the vendor gives consent to receive electronic copies of the 1099, all 1099s (current and previous year) will appear on this screen. ACH Setup tab. This will allow the vendor to set up (first time) or edit their banking information. Please keep in mind, they must submit a voided check or letter from the bank along with a photo ID and the signed ACH authorization form. Form W9 tab. The vendor needs to complete the W9 so that a 1099 can be properly issued. Once completed, the W9 will be approved inside the company account by the ADMIN. Once the vendor has created an account, you can request a W9 form from the vendor. Transaction Summary tab. This tab will list all of the transactions/payments that a vendor has received for a selected date range. Google Auth Setup tab. The vendor can set up a google authenticator here for their two-step verification for login purposes. This is not required.

label: Setting up Auto Vendor payments
text: Setting up Auto Vendor payments [the vendor must have had 1 successful ACH payment before auto vendor payment can be set up] Go to the ACCOUNTING module Click on the EXPENSE tab On the right-hand side of the screen, there will be ‘Auto Process Vendor Payment’; if none are set up, it will say NO. Click on the blue edit box to set up an auto process vendor payment. Click YES to choose to setup auto process vendor payment. Select the way you normally pay this vendor. (or select all to see all available vendors) If you had vendors set up for auto process, they would display here. To set up a new vendor, select NEW ASSIGNMENT. The next screen will display the available vendors for auto process. Click on the calendar icon to set up the auto process vendor schedule. The next screen displays all the payments to the vendor. Any of these can be used to set up the auto process vendor payment. I would suggest using the most recent. Click the calendar icon. The next screen allows you to set the schedule for the auto vendor payment. Frequency options: Interval means how many in between. For example, if you select MONTHLY, you would enter 0 for every month; 1 for every other month; 3 would be a quarterly payment and so on. ON MONTH would let you select the 3rd week of every month. Or if weekly, every Tuesday of the week. ON DAY (payment date); this is the day the vendor will receive the payment. Please keep in mind, the payment amount will be withdrawn from the company bank account 3 days before this day. For payment on Friday, the payment will process on Tuesday and will come out of the company bank account on Wednesday. END TYPE is either a date or occurrence. Most companies use date and use the end of the year or whenever the contract is completed. The ENABLE/DISABLE Auto payment allows you to turn off and on the process. Once you have entered all the information; please click SAVE & CLOSE. You can always go back to the AUTO PROCESS VENDOR PAYMENT and view all schedules in place.
